segments.text: We need to identify error type.
Source: "Der Luvwinkel oder Vorhaltewinkel, engl." Likely means "The windward angle or bearing angle, Eng." Actually "Luvwinkel" is "windward angle". "Vorhaltewinkel" maybe "bearing angle".
The translation given: "Not the Luv angle or retention angle, Engl." That seems wrong: It adds "Not" which is a negation error.
So error is Negation or Antonyms.
Also "retention angle" maybe wrong translation of "Vorhaltewinkel".
